description: This Java class 'RealHwTest' handles the process of connecting to real hardware via serial port, performing a hardware test, and logging the test results. It includes setup, execution, and cleanup logic for testing integration with hardware components in the project.

classes.name: RealHwTest
classes.description: Main class responsible for establishing connection with real hardware and executing hardware diagnostics

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the hardware test program, manages the test lifecycle, timing, and success/failure logging.

methods.name: startRealHardwareTest
methods.description: Initializes hardware testing parameters, determines serial port to use, and sets a flag indicating real hardware testing.

methods.name: runRealHardwareTest
methods.description: Performs the connection to hardware through the specified port and runs the main hardware test procedures.
